categories.main_business_segments: Techshine Electronics Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the professional display sector, focusing on the R&D, design, production, and sales of customized monochrome and color LCD screens, display modules, and touch screens. The company offers a comprehensive product portfolio including single-color LCD displays, single-color and color LCD modules, touch screens, and complex integrated modules. It serves specialized markets such as automotive electronics, industrial control and automation, smart home, healthcare, communication devices, and consumer electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including TFT-LCD, ITO glass, polarizers, flexible printed circuits (FPC), and integrated circuits (IC) in its manufacturing processes. It employs surface-mount technology (SMT), full lamination, OCA/OCR bonding, and specialized processes like 3D hot-press curved glass and die-casting integrated structures. Techshine integrates RTOS, Android, and Linux systems for deep integration in its display modules and focuses on innovations such as MiniLED backlight modules, variable light LC anti-glare rearview mirror modules, and smart serial port display modules.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers include terminal product manufacturers and technical service providers in industries such as automotive (notably supplying to BYD, Dongfeng, Changan), smart home, industrial automation, smart financial data terminals, healthcare, communication equipment, and consumer electronics. It maintains long-term strategic partnerships with major industry players like Deep Tianma, BOE, Honeywell, Hikvision, Johnson Controls, LG, Daikin, and others. Its products are sold domestically and exported to Europe, America, Japan, South Korea, India, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: Techshine Electronics operates primarily in China with production bases in Guangxi (Qinzhou Lingxian and Tanwei). It has an office in Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, and subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Japan. Its sales cover domestic markets extensively and international markets including Europe, America, Japan, South Korea, India, and Southeast Asia, with plans to deepen penetration in emerging Southeast Asian markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the LCD display industry supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and assembly of LCD panels and display modules. It procures upstream raw materials such as TFT-LCD panels, ICs, backlight units, touch panels, polarizers, FPCs, ITO glass, and chemical materials, and supplies downstream to terminal product manufacturers and technical service providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Techshine prioritizes technological innovation and product development in automotive electronics and complex integrated modules. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on high-reliability automotive FOB bonding, anti-peeping displays, 3D curved glass, integrated die-casting modules, MiniLED backlight modules, and Android-based solution boards. The company also pursues platform-based development strategies, integration of hardware and software solutions, and expansion into new application scenarios such as smart cockpits, IoT, AI, and digital signage. It plans to leverage industry funds to invest in semiconductor and electronic information sectors to enhance its ecosystem and competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of customized LCD screens and display modules, including both product sales and entrusted processing services. It operates on an order-driven production model, with sales to terminal product manufacturers and technical service providers. Revenue is recognized at the point of delivery and customer acceptance, with payment terms typically ranging from 30 to 120 days post-delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Techshine is positioned as a national high-tech enterprise with advanced capabilities in customized professional display solutions. It competes with major industry players such as Deep Tianma and BOE, maintaining strategic partnerships with them. The company differentiates itself through rapid response, integrated solutions, and a broad product matrix covering monochrome and color LCDs, touch screens, and complex modules. It holds a strong market position in automotive display segments and is expanding into emerging markets and new technology areas.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Techshine Electronics reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.48 billion, representing a 16.54% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached RMB 150.38 million, a 39.99% increase from the previous year. The company’s total assets grew by 15.76% to RMB 2.02 billion, and net assets attributable to shareholders increased by 8.58% to RMB 1.41 billion. The company maintains a healthy cash flow with operating cash flow increasing by 82.08%. It has a workforce of 2,293 employees, including 253 R&D personnel, and continues to invest about 4.73% of revenue in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Techshine emphasizes its ability to provide highly customized, integrated, and scalable professional display solutions with rapid response capabilities. Its products feature advanced technologies such as high-brightness TFT LCDs, curved and multi-screen modules, anti-peeping privacy displays, and integrated touch and display modules with embedded software platforms. The company’s comprehensive service model includes one-stop procurement and supply chain management, ensuring high quality, reliability, and customer-centric innovation. Its strategic focus on automotive electronics and complex modules positions it as a key partner for industry leaders seeking cutting-edge display technologies.
